A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same VIPLL research. Their complete text, equations, figures, tables, and references are readable and support reliable comparison. Neither supplied PDF contains an appendix.

before.justification: Section 5 and Tables 2–3 report original classification experiments on ten datasets, including comparisons with nine baselines and a causal-factorization ablation.

after.justification: Section 5 and Tables 2–3 retain those original experimental results and the ablation study.

M1.justification: Sections 4.1–4.5 and Algorithm 1 retain the same amortized Dirichlet posterior, CVAE generative model, maximum-entropy prior, candidate-set regularizer, and training and prediction procedures.

E1.justification: Both evaluate bird-song, lost, mir-flickr, msrc-v2, yahoo-news, MNIST, Fashion-MNIST, KMNIST, CIFAR-10, and CIFAR-100. The candidate-generation scenarios and represented tasks are unchanged.

E2.justification: Tables 2–3 retain the identical comparator set: PLKNN, PLECOC, PRODEN, VALEN, CAVL, PICO, POP, CROSEL, and CEL. Replacing 'benchmarks from the literature' with 'competitors' in Section 5.1 does not change their participation.

E3.justification: Reported settings remain unchanged, including MLP base models, 768-dimensional BLIP2 features for colored images, candidate-generation probabilities, 500 warm-up epochs, 1000 training epochs, and b = b′ = 10 Monte Carlo samples. No new evaluation protocol is introduced.

E4.justification: Section 5.3 retains the same ablation comparing the two causal factorizations, with the same ablated objective and results. Figure 2 retains the same candidate-label co-occurrence analysis. No additional robustness or sensitivity study appears.

E5.justification: Both versions report five repetitions, means and standard deviations, and t-tests at level 0.05 with the same significance-marking convention.

E6.justification: All 110 method–dataset accuracy entries in Tables 2–3 match exactly, including standard deviations and significance markers. Figure 2's heatmap data and Section 5.3's reported findings are also unchanged.

T1.justification: The mathematical definitions, assumptions, equations (1)–(14), and proofs of Propositions 4.3 and 4.4 are retained. Differences in equation wrapping and placement do not alter the mathematics.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction, and conclusion retain the same contributions and claims concerning posterior approximation, computational efficiency, architecture independence, predictive performance, and theoretical justification.

C2.justification: The explanations connecting the generative factorization to pre-training and prior information, and the interpretation of the ablation results, are unchanged. No substantive limitation, failure condition, or applicability qualification is added or removed.

D1.justification: V1 already advertises publicly available code and datasets. V2's Section 5 additionally explicitly includes the candidate-generation strategy in that availability statement, using the same repository. This is a limited disclosure clarification; implementation settings and access location remain unchanged.

R1.justification: The cited works and positioning relative to earlier PLL and variational-inference research remain the same. Bibliographic ordering, citation formatting, and small metadata additions do not change the research positioning.

P1.justification: The section sequence and substantive prose are retained. Local edits include changing 'benchmarks from the literature' to 'competitors,' revising the availability wording, and changing author/correspondence and citation presentation.

P2.justification: V2 reformats the document throughout: title and affiliation blocks, abstract typography, heading alignment, paragraph spacing, running headers, captions, and bibliography layout change. Figure 1, Table 1, and Algorithm 1 are repositioned, and linked citations and cross-references are introduced. The underlying figures and table structures are retained.

improvement.justification: V2 provides a modest usability improvement through linked citations and section/equation references, whose internal destinations resolve within the PDF. It also clarifies competitor terminology and explicitly identifies available candidate-generation material. The method, proofs, experimental evidence, and substantive discussion remain unchanged, so the overall gain is limited.
